text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High - customer Cumulus (private VPC) reporting elevated 502s from NLB -> ALB targets in privnet. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/privnet-nlb-alb-502>. Attaching alert summary and logs.

oncall-alex: ack - I'm taking this. adding netops + eng. starting triage. any brief impact numbers?

support-lia: customer ticket shows ~30% of requests failing with 502s over last 10m. They say B2B API errors, some partners affected. Customer-facing note drafted, holding until we have mitigation.

netops-raj: looking at target health: lots of ALB target health toggles ->
```
TargetID: i-0cumulus01 - unhealthy (502) - 15:12:31
TargetID: i-0cumulus02 - healthy (200) - 15:12:32
TargetID: i-0cumulus01 - healthy (200) - 15:12:33
TargetID: i-0cumulus01 - unhealthy (502) - 15:12:40
```
Pattern: rapid flapping on a subset of targets behind ALB. NLB shows upstream 502s when ALB target returns 502. No config changes on ALB recently.

eng-maya: I'm seeing kernel conntrack saturation on the tenant NAT instance handling Cumulus. conntrack_count: 64781 / max: 65536 -> approaching exhaustion. That causes asymmetric state and some return packets dropped -> 502s.

netops-raj: Also noticed an infra automation job applied an SG tweak 18m ago to the privnet SG list. sg-0ab12cde was added to block certain ephemeral IPs. Could be interacting with NAT state.

oncall-alex: customer impact confirmed. Plan proposal:
1) Temporarily move Cumulus traffic to their dedicated reserved pool in DC2 (no shared NAT there).
2) Add ephemeral inbound SG exception to allow NLB healthcheck IPs -> ALB targets to avoid state asymmetry.
3) Run targeted conntrack flush for Cumulus source CIDR on the NAT host.
We will monitor 502 rate and roll back changes if anything worse.

eng-maya: ready to run flush if netops gives green for SG change. Command I'll run (targeted):
```
sudo conntrack -D -s 10.244.32.0/24
sudo conntrack -L | grep 10.244.32
```
This will remove stale entries for Cumulus tenant CIDR only.

netops-raj: Pushing SG rule now - allow inbound from NLB healthcheck range (35.198.0.0/16) to ALB target port 8080 for privnet-target-sg. CLI:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0f12added --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 35.198.0.0/16 --description "temp allow NLB healthchecks for Cumulus mitigation"
```
I'll tag with incident:ness=8795550001. Applying in 30s.

oncall-alex: applying traffic move to reserved pool now (gradual weight shift). Will keep 10% incremental for 2m.

cust-thomas: confirmed, we see some requests time out, our clients log id=5f3a2c (15:11:42). Happy to test again after you flip.

eng-maya: SG rule in place (sg-0f12added). Running conntrack flush for 10.244.32.0/24.
```
flushed 4828 entries for 10.244.32.0/24
conntrack -L | grep 10.244.32 -> no entries
```

netops-raj: traffic shift complete. Cumulus now served from DC2 reserved pool. ALB healthchecks still succeed. Rolling back nothing yet.

incident-bot: Metrics update: 502 rate for Cumulus decreased from 30% to 2.1% over 6 minutes. (auto snapshot: https://dashboards/privnet/8795550001)

support-lia: notifying customer support ticket that we mitigated and asking them to validate partner traffic. Suggested customer-friendly write-up ready.

cust-thomas: running a few tests now against the same request id pattern - initial results look good, most requests succeed. We'll monitor for 30m and report.

oncall-alex: marking as partial_mitigated. Will remain on-call and keep monitoring for 2 hours. If 502s return, we'll escalate to platform incident. Thanks team.

eng-maya: follow-ups / postmortem actions:
- increase conntrack_max on tenant NAT instances (temporary uplift) + autoscale conntrack-aware.
- add healthcheck-specific SG whitelist as automated rollback after 1h.
- add alert to detect conntrack > 80% for tenant NATs.

netops-raj: I'll remove the temp SG rule after 1h if stable. sg-0f12added will be auto-cleaned, tracking in runbook.

incident-bot: handover note: oncall-alex will remain primary until 17:30 UTC; next rotation at 17:45. Incident channel archived on stable recovery.

oncall-alex: closing the active pager for now. Will update postmortem once RCA is ready. :white_check_mark:
